7.o: تعود جميلة إلى منزلها وتعلم بشأن استدعاء زوجها إلى قسم الشرطة وتلحق به مسرعة، فيما تتعرض والدة زوجة عبد العزيز للسرقة أثناء عودتها إلى المنزل وتفقد مال الوديعة.

8.o: تخبر جميلة كريم عن رغبتها بالانفصال عن والده. أما ياسمين، فتخبر والدتها عن رغبتها في التمثيل. من ناحية ثانية، ينجح كريم في الحصول على وظيفة جديدة في أحد المقاهي.

9.o: تخبر سكينة ابنتها جميلة عن رغبة الضابط حسام في الارتباط بكاميليا، فيما تسترق ياسمين السمع أثناء تحدث والدها ووالدتها وتكتشف أن قصة طلاقهما ليست سوى لعبة منهما لدفعها وشقيقها إلى تحمل مسؤولياتهما.

10.o: يخبر عبده زوجته سكينة بأنه اكتشف أمر تعرضها للسرقة وخسارتها لأموال الوديعة وبأنه يسامحها على ما حدث، فيما تتزور كاميليا عبد العزيز في مقر عمله فيغضب كثيرا ويوبخها على ذلك.

11.o: تتوجه جميلة إلى منزل والد زوجها وتكتشف مفاجأة صادمة، فيما يستمر عليوة في البحث عن أنصاف ويسأل أهالي المنطقة عنها.

12.o: يصطحب عبد العزيز أنصاف إلى منزل والدة زوجته ليضايقها، فيما يكتشف عبد العزيز تلاعب ابنته بأرقام الهاتف المخزنة في هاتفه النقال.

13.o: يحصل صبري على حقيبة النقود ويعرض الزواج على كاميليا، فيما تنشأ علاقة وطيدة بين عليوة ونادية. أما كريم، فيخطط للانتقام من غريمه نادر بعد أن قام بتصويره خلسة أثناء تواجده في المقهى.

14.o: يخبر عليوة عبد العزيز بضرورة التحدث إلى زوجته وتسوية أي خلاف بينهما، فيما تكتشف ياسمين أن شقيقها كريم كان السبب وراء فصل نادر من المدرسة.

15.o: تزور نادية عليوة في منزله وتتعرض للمضايقة من قبل أنصاف. أما عبد العزيز، فيعترف لابنه بأمر صادم يتعلق بعمله.

16.o: تخبر نادية شقيقها وجدي بأن عليوة تقدم لخطبتها، فيما يتم الاستغناء عن خدمات عبد العزيز في عمله الجديد بعد اكتشافهم بأن شهادة الخبرة التي قدمها مزورة.

17.o: يوافق عبد العزيز على العمل لدى إحدى معارض السيارات، فيما يعرض نادر على ياسمين الذهاب معه إلى الشاليه. أما عبد العزيز، فيتفق مع جميلة وأولادهم على ضرورة عودة سكينة إلى منزلها.

18.o: تذهب أنصاف بصحبة جميلة لزيارة نادية لتخبرها بأمر هام، فيما يتم القبض على شمندي بتهمة سرقة السيارة ويطلب السماح له بمقابلة صبري.

19.o: يصطحب نادر ياسمين إلى إحدى المقاهي ويفاجئها بحفل لعيد ميلادها ويقوم بتصويرها خلسة بمعاونة صديقتها. أما جميلة، فتطلب من ياسمين أن تبتعد عن نادر.

20.o: يزور صبري شمندي في السجن ويطلب منه اقتسام الأموال المخبأة في الحقيبة، فيما يتقرب حسام أكثر فأكثر من كاميليا.

21.o: يعرض باسم على صديقه القديم عبد العزيز أن يعمل لديه في وظيفة محاسب في دبي، فيما يزور حسام والد كاميليا ويطلب يد ابنته.

22.o: يقابل والد كاميليا حسام في المستشفى ويخبره عن سبب رفض ابنته له، فيما يخبر عليوة عبد العزيز بشأن خروج أنصاف من المنزل وذهابها إلى جهة مجهولة.

23.o: يهدد شمندي صبري ويطالبه بالنقود التي عثر عليها داخل السيارة المسروقة، فيما تدخل جميلة في حالة نفسية صعبة بعد استلامها بلاغات رسمية من مصلحة الضرائب والإدارة التعليمية.

24.o: يدعي صبري أثناء تحقيقات النيابة على حسام متهما إياه باستغلال نفوذه في إفشال ارتباطه بكاميليا، فيما يتعرض عبد العزيز إلى حادث سير في طريق عودته من مكتب المحامي.

25.o: يصدر وكيل النيابه حكمه بسجن صبري خمسة عشر يوما، فيما تتحاشى سكينة الحديث مع عبده في المنزل، أما الشرطة، فتعثر على أنصاف فاقدة للوعي في حديقة عامة.

26.o: تحاول جميلة مصالحة والديها، أما أنصاف فعادت إلى زيزو، بعد عودته الأموال إلى عبده قرر مصالحة سكينة، يحاول زيزو مصالحة جيرانه ، أحضر حسام لكاميليا عمل في شركة محاسبة، حدث سوء تفاهم بين كاميليا وحسام ولكن بعد معرفتها الحقيقة اعتذرت منه، ذهب زيزو إلى شركة التأمين لكنهم طلبوا منه بعض من الوقت، يقترح شريف على زيزو أن يفتح مشروع طعام خاص به.

27.o: طلب كريم وياسمين من زيزو أن يوافق على عملهما من أجل مساعدته في مصاريف البيت، ترفض جميلة عمل زيزو على سيارة بطاطا، ولكن غير زيزو خطته بعد أن أحضر له كريم وجبة سوشي من سيدة تدعي أوشين وبعد أن نجح مشروع زيزو ليأتي البوليس ويقبضوا على زيزو ويأخذوا العربة التي يعمل عليها، يعلم زيزو أن سكينة هى أوشين التي كانت تعد لهما الوجبات لبيعها.

28.o: يطلب حسام من كاميليا الزواج لكنها تطلب منه أن يعطيها وقت، حاول كريم الغش في الإمتحان ولكن يعتذر من المراقب لكي يُكمل الامتحان، طلبت جميلة من عليوة مسامحة نادية، يطلب عبدالفضيل من ميس نادية إجازة وتوافق ويعتذر منها ويسمعه عليوة وهو يصفها بالرقة والإنسانية ويغار عليوة، يزور باسم زيزو في بيته ويطلب منه العمل معه في دبي.

29.o: تحاول ميس نادية معرفة تغير عليوة معها وتطلب من جميلة التدخل، طلبت ولية أمر من جميلة إعطاء ابنها درس خصوصي لكنها رفضت، بعد معرفة ميس نادية بما سمعه عليوة أخبرت زيزو أنها مظلومة، يخُبر كريم، ياسمين أن باسم أحضر لزيزو عمل في دبي وتفرح ياسمين ولكنه يخُبرها كريم أن والدتها لم توافق ويقررا إقناع زيزو بالسفر، يأتي محامي إلى زيزو ليخبره أن أنصاف وارثه في قطعة أرض بمبلغ كبير ويريد المحامي أن ينهي عملية البيع ولكن ترفض أنصاف البيع.

30.o: يُخبر عليوة زيزو إنه سيتزوج بسيدة غير نادية ويجن جنون نادية بعد معرفتها، ترفض شركة التأمين تصليح سيارة زيزو، أما ياسمين تحاول إقناع أنصاف ببيع الأرض، يحاول زيزو التقرب من كريم وأصدقائه قبل السفر، أخذ زيزو أنصاف من أجل رؤية الأرض التي تملكها في بلدها.

31.o: يكتشف زيزو أن قطعة الأرض التي تملكها أنصاف أغلى من السعر الذي عرضه عليها المحامي، أغمي على عبده وأنقذه شهاب وتهتم به عائلته، يطلب عبده من زيزو الاهتمام بسكينة أذا حدث له شئ ودله على مكان وصيته، طلب عليوة من زيزو أن يذهبوا معه لاختيار فرش شقته هو ونادية.

32.o: بحثت سكينة في غرفة عبده لتجد الوصية حيث كتب فيها أنه كتب لها جميع أملاكه وعلمت أن عبده مريض بورم في الكلي، صارحت سكينة عبده بمعرفتها بمرضه وأقنعته بالعلاج، ودعت عائلة زيزو والدهما، عاد زيزو إلى عائلته بعد أن علم أن الفيزا والتذكرة مزوريين وأن باسم نصاب.

33.o: تهتم سكينة بعبده، تٌحضر نادية لحفل زفافها، أخبرت سكينة أبنتها بمرض والدها، وقف زيزو بجانب جميلة بعد معرفته بمرض والدها، قررت نادية أن تجمع أموال زفافها لمساعدة عبدالعزيز في مشروعه، بدأ عبده علاجه بمساعدة سكينة له.

34.o: وقفت عائلة زيزو بجانب عبده أثناء عمليته، وجدت ياسمين أموال في غرفتها واعتقدت أنها تخص أنصاف، بعد أن وجدت أنصاف الأموال أخبرت زيزو أن ربيع هو من أعطاها الأموال لتخبئتها ولكنها لم تعلم وتم القبض على ربيع، علم زيزو أن كريم يريد أن يستضيف شخص للإقامة في بلدة بمقابل ذلك يذهب كريم إلي بلد هذا الشخص للإقامة في بلده لكن رفض زيزو.

35.o: قررت نادية مشاركة زيزو في مشروعه، أحضر زيزو نتائج التحليل الخاصة بعبده وأظهرت النتائج أنه تعافى من مرضه، وجد كريم فتاة من روسيا تريد تبادل الإقامة معه، طلبت نادية من عليوة أنها لا تريد إعطاء أموال زفافها لزيزو، عاتبت أنصاف ربيع عما فعله، ترفض جميلة على إقامة فتاة روسية في بيتها ولكن يوافق زيزو على إحضار الفتاة الروسية.

36.o: يتضح لنا أن زيزو أتفق مع نادية من أجل إحضار الرقم السري الخاص بهاتف والده، ولكن حذف زيزو كل البيانات من على هاتف والده، ينزعج حسام بسبب تماطل كاميليا في الزواج منه، تطلب سكينة من عبده أموال لإجراء عملية تجميل، تكتشف جميلة أن ميس نادية جالسة مع شاب صغير وتعتقد أنها تخون عليوة ولكن يتضح لنا أن هذا الشاب هو ابن أخيها وجدي.

37.o: انفعل وجدي بعد معرفته بأقامة أبنه هيثم في بيت أخته وطلب منها أن تطرده، يحاول عبد العزيز وجميلة أخبار عليوة، طلبت نادية من عليوة المساعدة من أجل أن يقيم هيثم في بيته، فرح زيزو بعد معرفته الحقيقة، طلب عبده من جميلة مساعدته لإقناع والدتها بعدم إجراء العملية، بعد معرفة أنصاف بأن مجموعة بلطجية يريدون الاستيلاء على أرضها قررت الذهاب إلى بلدها وقرر زيزو مساعدتها، يتضح لنا أن هيثم اتفق مع والده وجدي للإيقاع بعليوة حيث وضعه له مخدرات في بيته.

38.o: تم القبض على عليوة ولكن تم الإفراج عنه بعد تأكد الشرطة بأن عليوة ليس له علاقة، طلب كريم من ياسمين أن تقيم ماريا الروسية في غرفتها، تغار جميلة بعد قدوم ماريا، فاجئت سكينة عبده وأخبرته أنها وضعت الأموال لمساعدة المرضى الذين يعانون من أمراض الكبد، يُخبر حسام كاميليا إنه سيتم نقله في العمل خارج القاهرة.

39.o: تغار جميلة من ماريا بسبب اهتمام زيزو بها، يعترف كريم بحبه لماريا ولكنها أخبرته إنها مرتبطة وسعدت جميلة بعد معرفتها بالخبر، يُخبر زيزو، عليوه ونادية أن مشروعه عن المزرعة لتربية الدواجن والمواشي وزراعة الخضار والفاكهة؛ رُحبت نادية بفكرة زيزو وشجعته، انفعل زيزو وجميلة بعد معرفتهما بدرجات كريم المنخفضة، وطلبت جميلة من زيزو أن يوافق على دراسة كريم في جامعة خاصة، يُخبر زيزو أولاده عن مشروع المزرعة.

40.o: تزوج عليوة ونادية، علم زيزو أن محسن هو من تسبب في طرده هو وكاميليا ورفض زيزو العودة إلى البنك للعمل على مشروعه، طلب زيزو من كريم الدراسة في كلية الزراعة للعمل معه في المشروع، بدأ زيزو مشروع الزراعة في أرض أنصاف، تزوج حسام وكاميليا، اكتشفت جميلة أنها حامل وفرح زيزو بالخبر، اتفقت العائلة على كتابة الأمنيات الجديدة بشرط بقاء المفتاح مع جميلة ولكن فتحت جميلة وزيزو الصندوق مجددًا.

3.o: When Joseph spots a fellow gang member in suspicious company, he secretly follows him and witnesses a horrifying betrayal.

8.o: Bino tries to help Joseph and gang mate Tisoy cover their tracks. But the police are hot on their heels and determined to catch them, dead or alive.

1.o: Yoriko is a whip smart civil servant hoping to ease her dad's worries. Takumi is educated but sponges off his mom. The two meet through an agency, and go on a date.

2.t: I Want to Parasite on You!! — Can You Fall in Love with a Higher-Class Loafer?
2.o: Yoriko questions whether she’s just “parasitizing” off Takumi’s lifestyle, while he wonders if she’ll resent him. Their relationship teeters between contractual convenience and something more.

3.t: First Matchmaking — First Contact with the Unknown!? — Rescue the Love-Incompetent Woman!!
3.o: They face matchmaking pressure—Yoriko’s friends assess Takumi, and Takumi worries they’ll judge him. They realize their “contract” relationship might not survive scrutiny.

4.t: Because There Is No Heart, She Can't Love — The Gift That Saves Her
4.o: Yoriko struggles to show warmth. Takumi decides to give her something meaningful, shaking the foundation of their relationship.

5.t: Forcing an Overnight Stay Plan!! First Kiss Marks the Beginning of Turbulence!?
5.o: An attempt to stay overnight leads to their first kiss—and new tension. They must decide if they're ready to risk emotional fallout.

6.t: First Visit to Her Parents' Home!! The Tear-Inducing Recipe of Miracles Is the Key to Love!?
6.o: Takumi visits Yoriko’s family on New Year’s Day, but freezes under pressure. A rival, Yutaka Washio, impresses everyone—forcing Takumi to face his feelings or lose her.

7.t: Children Don't Know Their Parents' Feelings!? Mother’s Last-Stage Preparation Pushes for Marriage!!
7.o: Takumi’s mother enters hospice and Yoriko reflects on her late mother. Together, they draft a marriage contract as a gesture of care for her mother

8.t: At Last the Engagement Ceremony!! Tearful True Confession — I Want to Try Real Love
8.o: Preparations for a formal engagement ceremony bring tears and heartfelt confessions—Yoriko seeks authenticity in love.

9.t: Two People Who Can't Love Truly Fell in Love — Birth of a Higher-Class Loafer and Thoughts of Marriage
9.o: Their “contract” unravels: both acknowledge they've fallen in love. Takumi confronts his identity beyond being a loafer.

10.t: Such a Declaration of Love Is Impossible…!? The Birthday Miracle That Sparks Fateful Love
10.o: On Yoriko’s birthday, a surprise party and Takumi's heartfelt confession culminate in a shared moment as they eat apples and kiss—love blossoms despite the odds.

5.o: Soares and Moreira pay a visit to Judge Barreto. After an encounter with Amaral, Silas changes direction. Trucco realizes Gringa is now a liability.

6.o: Mari's assault tears her family apart. When Moreira and Soares find clues linking Trucco to the Campello brothers, Silas decides a scapegoat is needed.

7.o: Silas seeks a financial backer for his political campaign. Soares and Moreira are sent to a safe house to guard Gringa. Renata delves into Silas's past.

8.o: Moreira uncovers the mole who caused the ambush and puts him to work. Silas does a dangerous favor for Amaral that lands him face to face with Trucco.

1.o: The Edo period. Daughter of a martial arts dojo, Rin embarks on a journey to take revenge for her slain parents. For her bodyguard on the journey, she has chosen the immortal man Manji, nicknamed the Slayer of Hundreds. Her target is the head of the Ittou-ryu, Kagehisa Anotsu, the man she hates. The adventure of the man who never dies and the girl who's sworn to live for revenge unfolds.

2.o: Rin announced that she will go meet with her father's friend Souri, the painter, in her journey for revenge. Souri cannot lend her a hand, but instead gives her funds. Rin, now with a full wallet and no leads, finds her father's sword at the blacksmith from which it was supposedly stolen. However, its wielder is a swordsman of the Ittou-ryu, 'Taito Magatsu.'

3.o: A prostitute approaches Manji as he waits for Rin. Though Manji sees through the prostitutes ruse, he accepts her invitiation. But this woman, 'Makie Otonotachibana', seem to weak to be a warrior of the Ittou-ryu as she claims. After sparing Makie's life, she appears before Manji again with different eyes and hair.

4.o: Wanting to become stronger herself, Rin received training from Manji, but is still a long way off from matching him in ability, much less the Ittou-ryu. Rin, in her melancholy, is drawn in by a sound, and finds a man training on his own. 'Some day I'll be like him', Rin tells herself, then is astonished upon seeing the man's face. It's her arch-nemesis, the head of the Ittou-ryu, Kagehisa Anotsu.

5.t: Act Five - Song of the Bugs
5.o: After seeing Kagehisa, Rin becomes weak at the knees. Lost in thought over her circumstances, Rin and her guard Manji are approached by a Buddhist monk. The monk is 'Eiku Shizuma' of the Ittou-ryu. He fights with Manji but is swiftly cut down. However, despite the lethal blow, Shizuma stands back up, his wound mending itself completely. Shizuma possesses an 'immortal' body, just like Manji.

6.o: Rin, who has come to see the festival, meets a cheeky little kid, Renzou. At the mask shop, things get dangerous between Manji and Araya, until Araya's son Renzou shows up and the hostility dissolves. Araya and Renzou then leave. Having watched Manji from behind, for some reason Rin continues glaring at Araya with eyes full of shock and hatred.

7.o: Discussions of the task of naming the instructor at the Ittou-ryu school, allotted them by the shogunate, have begun. They will make the Ittou-ryu's sword known to the world. Taito Magatsu vows to make that a reality, but decides to leave from Kagehisa Anotsu's side. At the same time, Ittou-ryu leaders start to be targeted. The tip of that blade is also pointed at Magatsu.

8.o: Manji and Rin involve the four known as Mugai-ryu, who hold information on Kagehisa, in order to assassinate him. Lying in wait on the road that leads out of Edo, based on information only known to Rin, she and Shira close in on Kagehisa as he tries to flee from the others.

9.o: Rin was told of Kagehisa's whereabouts by Giichi, and now her and Manji are suspected of indiscriminate murder. Suspected criminals cannot pass the checkpoint. But thanks to a maid who was acquaintance of Rin's, she has a countermeasure. She heads alone to a village that can help her slip through the checkpoint.

10.o: Manji wants to go after Rin, but he has no pass. That's when Souri and Magatsu appear before him. Souri tells Manji that he can acquire as many passes as Manji likes, but there's a condition. Meanwhile, a gray-haired, one-armed Shira appears before Hyakurin and Shinriji as they re-work their plan for assassinating Kagehisa.

11.o: Having become traveling partners for the sake of their goals, Manji and Magatsu are assaulted by a group of bald men. Manji, groaning in pain, is approached from behind by Shira, who then lops off Manji's arm. Shira had reconstructed his body, and desired a rematch with Manji. But now Magatsu, whose important woman was killed by Shira, stands in his path.

12.o: Having left for Kaga in pursuit of Kagehisa, a collapsed Rin is rescued by the very same Kagehisa. Then, having to cooperate with Kagehisa who is pursued by the Shingoto-ryu, Rin starts to see Kagehisa, her enemy, as a human being.

13.o: The Ittou-ryu had its members slaughtered by the shogunate. Kagehisa gathers the remaining members of Ittou-ryu in secrecy, and plots revenge against the shogunate. Manji is invited to the Mugai-ryu by Giichi, but he refuses, and they clash swords. Giichi's weapon breaks, so a truce is called. Manji decides to go meet the head of the Mugai-ryu, Habaki.

14.o: Habaki's scheme gets Manji trapped in a dungeon. Habaki uses a doctor, Burando Ayame, to try and solve the mystery of the immortality. For the sake of the advancement of medicine, Burando sinks a scalpel into Manji's body. Meanwhile, while waiting for Manji's return, Rin is caught up in a strange cohabitation with Doua and Isaku, who had been searching for a place to stay.

15.o: Burando succeeds in transplanting Manji's left arm onto the test body of Dewanosuke. From that starting point, more tests succeed. But Habaki puts pressure on Burando, and demands results. Habaki's blade closes in on the imperfectly immortalized Dewanosuke. Rin meets with Doua and Isaku in the street as she searches for Manji. That's when the official that Doua knocked over appreaches them.

16.o: Ever since the Dewanosuke incident, Burando kept making blunders. He is finally thrown in solitary confinement by Habaki, and goes insane. But as a result of his madness, Burando grasps something important about the immortality experiments: That humans are essentially otters. Meanwhile, Rin and Doua resolve to infiltrate Edo Castle to rescue the surrounded Manji and Isaku.

17.o: Manji and Rin finally reunite. But the formidable foe they made in Habaki in the dungeon blocks their escape. Then Doua and the presumed dead Isaku arrive as backup. The dungeon begins to cave in. As their escape nears, an unexpected person appears before Rin and Manji. Then, the answer that Burando arrived at from the results of his experiments...

18.o: After his failure at Edo Castle, Habaki is dismissed as head clerk. But still, in order to annihilate the Ittou-ryu, he heads up the Rokki-dan in hopes of subjugation. However, the new head clerk, Ugen, decides that Ittou-ryu, having left Edo, is now in the clear. Furthermore, to ensure he abides by the agreement, Habaki's wife and children are taken hostage.

19.o: The Ittour-ryu are pursued by the Rokki-dan, lead by Habaki. Upon hearing this, Run and Manji decide to pursue as well. Even with all these people leaving Edo to chase the Ittou-ryu, the four leasers appointed by Kagehisa Anotsu are nowhere to be found. Then, in the wee hours of the morning, Kagehisa and the other three stand at the Ootemon in front of Edo Castle.

20.o: Rin and Manji chase after Kagehisa, but Shira attacks them and Rin is taken away. Manji goes to rescue her, and meets not only Shinra, but Renzou as well. Manji fights Shinra in order to rescue Rin. But astoundingly, what slashes at Manji is Shira's left arm, which should have been lost.

21.o: Manji is wounded from his duel with Shinra. Renzou picks up a sword and tries to kill Manji, but Rin and the others talk him down. Meanwhile, Habaki is livid upon learning of the attack on Edo Castle. Habaki wants to pursue Ittou-ryu, even in absence of its leader. As a result, one of the Ittou-ryu enters a mountain village. Habaki's daughter, Ryou, tries to subdue him to be of use to her father.

22.t: Act Twenty Two – Ten Final Pushes
22.o: Arashino, Hasshuu, and Murasaki of the Rokki-dan act as the vanguard in the clash with the Ittou-ryu. The crucial Abayama manages to escape with the help of his followers. But then he hast to confront Giichi and Hyakurin, who pursued Abayama to assist Habaki.

23.o: The Ittou-ryu, Rokki-dan, and Manji and Rin all gather in Nakaminato, as if guided there. They all bear their motives on their swords in the moment they begin their final deathmatch. Deceive, subdue, and dance in chaos. Sparks will fly in the decisive batte between the strongest. The last laugh belongs to...

24.t: Final Act – Blade of the Immortal
24.o: The lives of those gathered fizzle out one after another. Those remaining are battered and bruised. Yet still they take up their swords, and slam their convictions against one another. The last one standing... And the revenge that was fulfilled... The curtain now closes on the tale of the man with an eternal life, and of those people whose finite lives were a blaze of passion.

1.o: هل هو جدّ وديع من كليفلاند أم الحارس النازي سيئ السمعة المعروف بلقب «إيفان الرهيب»؟ جرائم حرب من الحرب العالمية الثانية لا تزال تُلاحق قضائيًا بعد كل هذه السنين.

2.o: يشهد ناجون من معسكر الإبادة في تريبلينكا ضد المتهم ويتهمونه بأنه «إيفان الرهيب»، فيما يبحث محاموه عن سبل للطعن في مصداقية الشهادات ضده.

3.o: يحاول الدفاع تقويض شهادة محورية لأحد الناجين، ويطعن في صحة بطاقة هوية مستخرجة من سجلات المخابرات السوفيتية، ويتوصل إلى اكتشاف مذهل في مكب نفايات لمطعم وجبات سريعة.

4.o: ما إن يصدر الحكم المنتظر حتى يؤدي سقوط جدار برلين إلى الإفراج عن أدلة جديدة من أرشيف المخابرات السوفيتية، ما يقلب المحاكمة رأسًا على عقب.

5.o: تصدر المحكمة العليا الإسرائيلية حكمها النهائي في القضية، لكن مزيدًا من المفاجآت في الانتظار.

1.o: Lee Ahn is a boy with an incredible power to sense other people's secrets just by a simple touch. Yoon Jae-in is a girl who'll stop at nothing to hide a traumatic secret. What will happen when their worlds collide? A romantic thriller about how these two teenagers love, heal, and support each other through big and small events.

3.t: Can You Keep a Secret for Me?
3.o: The math teacher who got fired because of Jae In uncovering the truth tries to retaliate. An appears at the right moment to save Jae In and he continues to stay with her to protect her. However, the secret Jae In wanted to hide from everyone has been revealed and she disappears.

4.t: I Found You, Yoon Jae In
4.o: After two years, An and Jae In meet again. Jae In has become a police officer while An doesn’t seem to have made much progress in honing his psychometry skills. While they are both trying to find a kid that went missing, An finds a suspicious suitcase that turns out to have a dead body in. Will the two be able to find the killer?

5.o: Seong Mo asks Jae In to help improve An’s psychometric powers. While Jae In hesitates to let An perform a read on her, An realizes that she’s the girl he remembers from long ago. Meanwhile, Dr. Hong identifies the body found in the suitcase, and while following Seong Mo, An meets a mysterious man.

6.t: The Culprit of the Yeongseong Case
6.o: As Seong Mo wished, Jae In promises to help train An’s abilities. As An is discharged from the hospital, he and Jae In start to read books on crimes. To find more information on the real Kang Hee Sook, Ji Soo calls An and Jae In to the autopsy room.

7.o: An realizes his ability can improve and help others only if he challenges himself. Slowly but surely, he is making efforts to change. With An’s ability, Seong Mo and Ji Soo identifies the killer and gathers information on his gang. They plan to raid the gang’s headquarter, but gets denied for not presenting evidence or witness.

8.o: An and Jae In gets caught after infiltrating Dragon Head Hunting. Soon after they fight their way out, the police raid the building with overwhelming manpower. After a successful raid and interrogating the thugs, Ji Soo and Seung Mo realize this case is bigger than they imagined.

9.t: I'll Give You Only Good Memories
9.o: Dr. Hong and Ji Soo discover something strange from the autopsy of Kang Eun Joo. Moreover, they are shocked that the composite sketch of Kang Hee Sook looks like Eun Joo. Meanwhile, An and Jae In go on a first date. With his unusual ability, An accidentally finds out that Jae In’s father was the culprit of the arson at Yeongseong Apartment.

10.o: An is terribly shocked to know that Jae In’s father was the arsonist of Yeongseong Apartment fire, and he runs away from Jae In. Ji Soo strongly believes that Seong Mo’s mother is still alive and is now living as Kim Song Hee. However, Ji Soo doesn’t understand why Seong Mo keeps it as a secret to her. Meanwhile, the security camera around the security center is down again, and Jae In runs into a suspicious man.

11.t: The Kidnapping of Yoon Jae In
11.o: Jae In is kidnapped by a mysterious man who looks familiar to her. Although the police have his picture from the security camera footage, they still can’t catch him. Seong Mo disappears and Ji Soo keeps tracing where Eun Joo is and finds out that she attempted suicide on the day she made a briefing about Kim Gab Yong and the two victims. Meanwhile, Ji Soo investigates Eun Joo’s background and is about to dig out Seong Mo’s awful childhood.

12.o: Ji Soo, together with Jae In and An, go to where Eun Joo first lived and find out her and Seong Mo’s painful past, that they were trapped in a basement with shackles for nine years. Besides, they also find out that Yeongseong Apartment fire, Hanmin Care Home fire, the murder of Kim Gab Yong were all committed by Kang Geun Taek, the man who confined Seong Mo and Eun Joo and abducted Jae In. However, there is another cruel truth awaiting Ji Soo.

13.o: An finds out that Seong Mo knew Kang Geun Taek was at Kangguk Station and that he sent An and Jae In to somewhere else to save their lives. An keeps blaming himself. Meanwhile, Eun Joo is questioned by the police. She starts to talk everything she remembers from the Hanmin Care Home.

14.t: Memories Can Sometimes Even Fool Your Own Self
14.o: An tries to make Eun Joo talk again, but he fails to get anything from her. Meanwhile, the police find surveillance camera footage of Seong Mo. According to the footage, they start to track Seong Mo. Jae in and Lieutenant Nam head to a hospital where they believe Geun Taek is confined.

15.t: Did You Really Kill Kim Gab Yong?
15.o: Seong Mo takes Eun Joo out from the police station. After Seong Mo helps Eun Joo’s identity get reinstated, they part ways. Meanwhile, An starts to track what he saw in his vision, and he ends up at Yeongseong Apartment. An and the police find Kang Geun Taek in an empty unit. An also sees what Seong Mo did in the past in the apartment.

16.o: An sees in his vision that it was Seong Mo who framed Geun Taek to protect his mother. Found at Unit 1501, right before his arrest Seong Mo confesses to An about everything. Seong Mo admits all of his crimes and even hands out the ledger he had that includes all bribery behind YSS Construction and high authorities. Jae In, An, and the whole Investigative Unit come together to finally put things back to where it should be.

1.o: A smashing Lena Meyer-Landrut hit. A soaring Sia's "Chandelier" performance. These women are set to sing their hearts out and hit those Golden Notes.

2.o: One player's got his eyes firmly fixed on the whopping prize as the contestants tackle swoon-worthy classics like Celine Dion's "My Heart Will Go On."

3.o: A street musician and a bartender battle for a place in the sun and take on hits such as Daft Punk's "Get Lucky" and Juli's "Perfekte Welle."

4.o: Primed to party with a Maroon 5 chart-topper, these competitors are ready to shoot for the stars and move like Jagger.

5.o: The contestants rock the house with anthems from Aerosmith and Bon Jovi — but who's got the star quality worthy of a Palina Performance Prize?

6.o: Decked out in puff sleeves and spandex leggings, Palina sets the '80s mood as the players cover the era's iconic tracks, from Rick Astley to Madonna.

7.o: Soundtrack faves like "Shallow" and "Mamma Mia" are on the bill. Grab the popcorn for a nail-biting, rousing finale that's just the ticket for fun.

1.o: يواجه "يون جونغ يو" الحظّ السيّئ في يومه الأوّل في المدينة الكبيرة، حيث يجد مكانًا رخيصًا ليقيم فيه ويقسم أنه لن يظلّ هناك سوى لفترة قصيرة.

2.o: ينال "جونغ يو" اهتمامًا غير مرغوب فيه من جيرانه، لكنه يجد تجاهلًا تامًّا من مديره في العمل، ويُعثر على قطط ميتة بالقرب من مسكن "إيدن".

3.o: يقابل "جونغ يو" "سيو مون جو"، الذي يحظى بإعجابه، على سطح المسكن وينسجمان بسبب اهتمامهما المشترك بالجريمة والفنّ.

4.o: ينتاب "جونغ يو" شعور بالريبة تجاه "مون جو" وطبق اللحم مجهول المصدر، فتصبح كوابيسه أكثر رعبًا، وتنكشف أكاذيب "أوم بوك صن".

5.o: يكتشف "جونغ يو" أن شخصًا مجهولًا قد اقتحم غرفته. ولكن قبل أن يتمكّن من اللحاق به، يوجّه إليه "مون جو" نصيحة على انفراد... فهل يستمع إليه؟

6.o: تمرّ "مين جي أون" على مسكن "إيدن" وحدها فيما يسرع "جونغ يو" إلى هناك برفقة شرطيين، فتنفجر غضبًا من انفعاله المبالغ فيه... لذا يقرر المغادرة.

7.o: يثق "جونغ يو" في جارٍ انتقل حديثًا ليعيش قبالته ويتّفقان على الاعتناء ببعضهما، فيما يكشف تحقيق "سو جيونغ هوا" أخيرًا عن بعض الأدلّة.

8.o: يساعد "مون جو" "جونغ يو" حين يتمّ القبض عليه بعد تورّطه في مُشاجرة، لكنّ هذا التصرّف النبيل يزيد من خوف "جونغ يو" ويثير غضبًا كامنًا داخله.

9.o: حين يشكّ "جونغ يو" أن رسالة "كانغ سيوك يون" هي صرخة استغاثة، يعود إلى مسكن "إيدن" لإخراجه، لكن "سيوك يون" ينفعل ويعترف أنها كانت مجرّد مزحة.

10.o: يحرّض "مون جو" "جونغ يو" على ارتكاب أوّل جريمة قتل إن أراد رؤية "جي أون" مجدّدًا. وعندما يرفض "جونغ يو"، يستاء جاره المتعطّش للدماء.

1.o: At the turn of the 20th century, tensions in Europe are rising. After the death of her son Norman John, Margaret, a young woman trapped in a violent marriage, flees to Europe with her young daughter Nonn.

2.o: Margaret works to make ends meet and return to Nonn. An opportunity to move in with a family and become a horse trainer finds Nonn tangled in a web of temptation and betrayal.

3.o: Now a musical performer in the streets of Paris, Margaret finds powerful backing from a wealthy benefactor.

4.o: In an effort to restore her reputation, Margaret has an arranged marriage with Astruc. In Paris, she runs a flower shop - but a world of danger and darkness lies beneath the veneer of happiness.

5.o: Margaret is now Mata Hari, a superstar performing artist in a torrid affair with the powerful Castello. When she meets prestigious art patron Sergey, Mata Hari finds herself at another crossroads.

6.o: In 1910, Mata Hari discovers an intimate betrayal, drawn into a web of double-crossings and murderous cover-ups.

7.o: As World War I dawns on the horizon, Russian intelligence tights its investigation into German spies.

8.o: In 1915 Paris, Mata Hari finds herself tied to a brutal murder. Soon, French police are following her every move.

9.o: Facing tragedy, Mata Hari fights for justice, and plans a potentially explosive book with Lenoir.

10.o: As violence explodes in the streets, Mata Hari finds her affairs and alliances bringing her closer to danger.

11.o: After a shocking murder, Mata Hari finds herself with a deadly driver, on a ride that could be her last.

12.o: Facing prison time for espinage, Mata Hari fights for her freedom.

1.o: لا حكم عليه

2.o: Noor and Amin get married and have a child. Meanwhile, Zaman takes the lawyer’s oath and visits Naseem.

3.o: Upon the discovery of new evidence, the court grants Naseem a retrial while an enraged Ghassan discusses the case with his brother and the lawyer.

4.o: A downhearted Naseem recalls memories of his diseased mum. Meanwhile, Ghada warns Zaman against further investigating the murder.

5.o: Naseem visits his mum’s grave and finds himself up against the wall while Zaman rushes to the rescue. Later, he finds out about the latter’s past.

6.o: Nasim finds his mum’s marriage certificate and decides to defend her against everyone. Later, he confronts Ghassan and his brother.

7.o: Zaman shares an important matter with Nasim and talks to Ghassan and his brother about their dad. Later, Nasim seeks Wael’s help to keep tabs on someone.

8.o: Nasim finds himself up against the wall when he sneaks into Noor’s house. Later, Zaman feels unwell and Nasim rushes to the rescue.

9.o: Nasim recalls his last conversation with Noor and later asks to meet her. Meanwhile, Ghassan gets into trouble and Noor tries to help.

10.o: Nasim eavesdrops on Akram’s conversation and learns something important. Later, a victim escapes the clutches of the organ trafficking gang and reports them.

11.o: Nasim thinks that Wael is conspiring against him while the latter walks into Akram’s trap. The gang resumes work from their new den.

12.o: Zaman blames herself for what happened to Nasim. Later, the story of the boy who survived the kidnapping makes headlines.

13.o: Nasim is in for a surprise when he receives the result of the DNA test. Meanwhile, Amin confronts Noor with photos of her with Nasim.

14.o: Zaman spots two people outside her place watching her while an unexpected guest shows up at Nasim’s place. Later, Carla gets followed when she meets Dr. Wasim.

15.o: SEASON FINALE: Nasim tries to make Amin confess to killing his mum. Later, Ghassan takes Nasim and Zaman to an abandoned warehouse with a plan in mind.

1.o: Roback faces disciplinary action, Alvarez deals with trauma on the job and learns shocking news from home, and Roback and Davis's money-making scheme doesn't go as planned.

2.o: Roback, Davis, and Petrocelli make their way back to base through treacherous desert. Roback makes a grand gesture to help out Alvarez, complicating things with Durkin. Holloway takes a special interest in one of her patients.

3.o: Roback, Davis, and Alvarez go on a mission to find Qasem. Alvarez makes an unexpected friend. Roback opens up to Durkin, and tries to salvage the fight with Sasquatch.

4.o: Roback scrambles to keep a promise. Sasquatch reminds the guys they have unfinished business. Holloway has plans to help Qasem's village.

5.o: A coordinated attack catches the base by surprise. Davis and Roback stumble upon an unusual operation in the Afghan hills. Alvarez helps Hazara.

6.o: Col. Austin brings the hammer down hard on Roback, Davis, and Alvarez. Davis brokers the big fight with Sasquatch. Qasem helps Holloway at her medical clinic.

7.o: A visiting dignitary arrives on base; Davis seeks a new side hustle as pressure from home becomes unbearable; Durkin and Sasquatch have a fight about their future.

8.o: Roback and Davis attempt a seemingly impossible rescue through an old mine field. SecCorp accelerates its plan. Durking steps up to help Petrocelli.

9.o: The gang discovers the solution to many of their problems, but getting their hands on it won't be easy. Holloway gets a surprise visit. Davis struggles with a major decision.

10.o: The gang heads deep into Taliban country to recover the lost quarter of million dollars. Colonel Austin makes his final push against SecCorp.

1.o: After having the worst day of her life, Tak Dong-gyeong wishes for the world to end. A stranger shows up at her door to make that desire a reality.

2.o: Dong-gyeong realizes that the hundred-day pact with Myeol-mang comes with heavy consequences if she refuses to fulfill her end of the bargain.

3.o: As Dong-gyeong deals with a demanding new roommate, she looks for a loophole in her agreement with Myeol-mang to save her loved ones from doom.

4.o: In a desperate attempt to destroy Myeol-mang by winning him over, Dong-gyeong seeks the help of a romance expert.

5.o: Puzzled by Dong-gyeong's act of self-sacrifice, Myeol-mang decides to keep close tabs on her to figure out her true intentions.

6.o: Dong-gyeong looks for another subject to fall in love with. Na Ji-na attends a high school reunion hoping to see an old flame.

7.o: Myeol-mang comes to a difficult decision after being reminded of the part he played in bringing grief and sadness into Dong-gyeong's life.

8.o: After a short-lived reunion, Dong-gyeong has her love and trust in Myeol-mang tested while he navigates a world where she never existed.

9.o: Lee Hyeon-gyu shows up at Ji-na’s door to get something off his chest. Dong-gyeong goes on a shopping spree to prepare for a final goodbye.

10.o: Myeol-mang makes a heartfelt confession. A writer accuses Ji-na of plagiarism. Dong-gyeong makes a painful choice to save her loved ones.

11.o: After spending time with good company, Dong-gyeong returns to her old life while Myeol-mang finds himself transformed. Ji-na works on a new series.

12.o: Myeol-mang punishes criminals who run free. Dong-gyeong meets a ghost at the hospital. Ji-na and Hyeon-gyu feel a growing distance between them.

13.o: Myeol-mang keeps an eye on Dong-gyeong hoping to figure out who she is. Ji-na clears the air with Hyeon-gyu but makes up her mind to move on.

14.o: After promising a life together, Myeol-mang and Dong-gyeong make the most of the time they have left.

15.o: Upon receiving a second chance, Dong-gyeong moves forward with her life, while holding on tightly to the memories of her past.

16.o: Having found the person to spend the rest of her life with, Dong-gyeong finds hope and meaning for the future.

1.o: Garrett and his unit travel to Thailand when three American volunteers go missing during a trek to Bangkok. Once there, former colleague Clara Seger, a cultural anthropologist, helps them rush to gather evidence leading to the UnSub before a storm threatens to wash it away,

2.o: When an American man attending a festival in Mumbai wakes up missing a kidney and his friend gone, the International Response Team’s investigation leads them to suspect the UnSub is more than just trading organs on the Black Market.

3.o: The International Response Team heads to Cairo when an Egyptian-American former U.S. serviceman is killed in a gas attack there and his friend goes missing.

4.o: The team travels to Japan to assist local law enforcement in investigating homicides made to look like suicides. Meanwhile, Mae encourages Clara to get out and enjoy herself.

5.o: The International Response Team heads to Paris to search for an UnSub targeting Americans who live there.

1.o: As Sabah leaves the market, she returns home to take care of her mother, while she suffers from the cruel treatment of her neighbor, Alkat'a, who wants to throw her and her family out. The rivalry in the market intensifies between Sa'dawy and Omar. Hassan clashes with Abdo who bothers Sabah.

12.o: As Umm Badr (Badr's mother) refuses Badr's marriage to Sabah, she leaves the house and goes to Sa'dawy's. Sabah refuses to marry Abdo, and her father tries to assault her. Badr marries Sabah. Gamila returns the dowry to Abdo.

15.o: Gamila refuses to marry the son of the mechanic. As Tofaha asks Nabawy to buy the tea stand owned by Hassan's father, Sabah buys it and asks Umm Hamdy to run it. When Ruqia dies, Irfan is devastated. Abdo returns as the owner of a transport company and tries to get closer to Gamila.

17.o: Sa'dawy attacks Alkat'a because of the presence of his wife and daughter with her. Alkat'a tries to attack Gamila, but Sabah stops her. Gamila decides to marry Abdo without the knowledge of her family. When Alkat'a is found dead, Sabah gets arrested. Shawkat tells Camellia that he has cancer.

18.o: As Sabah denies having anything to do with the crime, she's officially accused of killing Alkat'a. Abdo divorces Gamila and deliberately humiliates her. Sabah's father is accused of robbing Sa'dawy’s shop.

19.o: Irfan holds a celebration for his nephew Omar after his birth. Abdo incites Sa'dawy against Omar. As Sabah is tried in court, Abdo testifies against her, and she is sentenced to life with hard labor. Omar asks Irfan to get married.

20.o: Sabah’s mother dies of grief, and Hassan’s father dies also. Sabah gives birth to a boy in prison and names him Shebel. Gamila flees from the neighborhood after Abdo compels her to return obediently to the conjugal home.

22.o: As Omar's son, Hisham, dies by drowning in the swimming pool, Omar stays away from work but tries to follow up on the supply company with Shawkat. Omar returns to the market after a break, but refuses to return to Camellia. Irfan tries to convince Omar to start over.

23.o: Years later, Omar marries Gamila. Sa'dawy agrees to wed his daughter to Abdo, despite Badr's refusal. Irfan's life is saved after two thieves break into his house, and they confess that they killed Alkat'a years ago. Everyone celebrates Sabah's release from prison.

31.o: Abu Khotwa supplies vegetables and fruits to Sabah and her friends in the market. As the relationship between Abu Duma and Sabah grows stronger, he offers to take part in the supply of potatoes. As Sabah goes to the supply company with Gamila, she meets Shawkat, who shows his support to them.

33.o: Fetouhy confesses to Sabah that he fled after killing his wife and her lover. Hassan returns after an absence. Sa'dawy discovers that Abdo forged Badr's sales paper. As Mahrous dies in a shootout with the police, Abdo is arrested. Sa'dawy goes insane. Sabah takes Shebel to live with her.

34.o: Sabah travels with Fetouhy to Alexandria to look for his son. The university decides to dismiss Sherif. Shawkat flees abroad after he seized the company’s funds. Ali and Sherif run the trade of Abu Hashima. As Amna poisons Abdo, Irfan returns to the market. Sabah’s business expands with her son Shebel.

1.t: Two Stars Meet in the Desert
1.o: A man who fell into the desert has no memory. He is named Daisuke and hits it off with Koji Kabuto, who picked him up. As unidentified forces attack the Earth, a giant robot called Grendizer appears.

2.o: Duke defeats the Vega forces, but loses his senses and flies away eventually landing on Ogami Island. Koji follows him and just as he meets the island's shrine maiden Hikaru, his arch enemy Cassado attacks Earth.

3.o: Duke's anger burns up in the despicable cassado. He makes Grendizer run wild, but he remembers his promise to Koji and stops. Duke regrets that he got on again and cheers of gratitude.

4.t: The Flower of Love Bloomed in the Sky
4.o: Reunion with childhood friend Naida. It brings a brief moment of peace to Duke. However, she approached Duke as an enemy of her brother Sirius. The blade of love and hate is approaching.

5.o: Duke's sister, Maria, came to earth after her brother. However, Maria looks down on the unexplored planet Earth with girlish arrogance. Meanwhile, the Vega army will attack again.

6.o: Teronna, a female knight who can be said to be Duke's best friend, landed on Earth. Unlike the previous Vega army, Teronna offers a fair game, but she condemns Duke as a planet sinner.

7.t: Horror in the Depths of the Sea

8.o: Duke receives a message from the flying beast and reunites with Rubina, who has come down to Earth. Duke begins to tell the truth about the tragedy on Planet Fleed.

10.o: Koji and the others activate the new Mazinger and finally start a counterattack. On the other hand, a masked man aiming for Duke was waiting for him on Wolf Island. Duke and Teronna make a temporary truce to counter.

11.o: Berlin was destroyed by the Super Vega curved gun. Malice is spreading on Earth, and the spearhead is being directed at Duke. In order to stop any more conflicts, Rubina and Duke meet secretly.

12.o: Koji and his friends enlist Hikaru's help to destroy the Super Vega Cannon and head off into space. The Vega Star dispatches the strongest Vega beast to fight back. Duke reunites with Rubina and Teronna, and the three of them share their feelings on the moon.

13.t: In Honor of this Wonderful Land
13.o: Red flowers were scattered. Duke, who was swallowed up by anger, once again made Grendizer run wild. If we don't kill Duke, won't Grendizer stop? The time for Koji to make a choice is approaching.

3.t: To Remember, or Not to Remember
3.o: تجد "ليلى" شريكًا غير متوقع أثناء بحثها عن الحقيقة، لكنها تكتشف خلافًا مقلقًا. وفي إحدى الحفلات الفاخرة، يُقبَض على "يحيى" في مطاردة.

4.o: يسعى "يحيى" للعثور على تسجيلات لمقاطع فيديو من يوم مقتل "ناديا"، لكن يتحتم عليه التخلص من أحد القتلة المأجورين أولًا. أما "ليلى"، فتواجه والدها بشأن الماضي.

5.o: يعود "يحيى" لمسرح الجريمة معتقدًا بأنه المكان الوحيد الذي سيجد فيه إجابات على أسئلته. فيما تكتشف "منى" أمرًا مذهلًا من ماضيها!

6.o: تثير عودة "منى" إلى القاهرة الشكوك في كل شيء، فيما يواجه "يحيى" أحد الأشخاص بشأن موت "ناديا".

7.o: تطرح "ليلى" أسئلة على "يحيى" لفهم نواياه، ويوجّه "ياسين" إنذارًا صادمًا لزوجته.

8.o: مع تضييق "يحيى" الخناق على أهدافه، تستجوب "ليلى" عائلتها لتكتشف أخيرًا سبب إلقاء الماضي ظلاله على حاضرهم.

7.o: Wu rushes to visit his aunt after getting a worrying call about her health, but Jin insists on accompanying him to the remote village.

8.o: Rui teaches Wu how to use social media, but his first post causes Jin to worry that peer pressure may be clouding his studies.

9.o: When Wu takes the fall for a friend's poor behavior at school, Jin intervenes to smooth things over with his professors — and his angry aunt and uncle.

10.o: Wu stands up to a group of bullies who mock his humble background. In 2024, Jin goes on a dinner date with Lu Weiyan.

11.o: Juggling a complicated pitch at work, Jin clashes with her colleague Li Fei. Wu helps her find creative inspiration.

12.o: At an archery range, a jealous Wu uses small ploys to monopolize Jin's attention and keep her from getting too close to Weiyan.

13.o: Concerned that Wu lives right across the hall from Jin, Weiyan probes her about their complicated relationship.

14.o: Chun Chang flirts with Shen Yiyang, who promises to help her with the bar. Wu pushes his team to hit an important deadline.

15.o: As Wu prepares to take his final college entrance exam, a sentimental gift from Jin steadies his nerves. In the present, Wu struggles to sleep.

16.o: When Jin's mother invites Weiyan over for dinner, Wu volunteers to help cook the meal. At the bar, Yiyang steps in to help Chang.

17.o: Despite receiving offers from several prestigious universities, Wu decides he'd rather attend a school nearby — and stay as close to Jin as possible.

18.o: In Wu's room, Jin stumbles upon a photo of herself hidden among his school supplies and begins to question their entire relationship.

19.o: In 2018, a leg injury forces Jin to rely on Wu for everyday tasks around the home, leaving her reevaluating their situation.

20.o: Encouraged by their deepening friendship following Jin's injury, Wu rushes to surprise her after work and makes a bold move.

21.o: A model pulls out of Jin's commercial shoot at the last minute, forcing her to quickly find a replacement. Luckily, Wu is eager to lend a hand.

22.o: Fearing that their new bond is holding Wu back from pursuing an international exchange program, Jin secretly plans a bold career move to protect him.

23.o: When Wu discovers her deception, Jin must choose between her own happiness and his future success — even if it means losing him forever.

24.o: After six long years of pining over lost love, Wu and Jin openly reconcile their true feelings and begin a new chapter in their relationship.

25.o: Wu gives a presentation at a major conference. Jin receives an invitation to a colleague's wedding — and worries she'll run into her ex-husband.

26.o: After seeing photos from the wedding, Jin's mother drops by for a surprise visit and confirms her suspicion that Wu is interested in her daughter.

27.o: Shifting into crisis mode, Wu and Rui desperately seek alternative funding as investors begin to pull out of their project.

28.o: Rui and Wu collaborate on a pitch that could save their struggling company. Meanwhile, Chang organizes a romantic date with Yiyang.

29.o: Jin's parents debate whether Wu is a good match for their daughter. Chang and Yiyang work through their own family tensions.

30.o: Yiyang asks an important question. After her family invites them to dinner as a couple, Jin and Wu look to their future together.
